source_products.methodology: Historical MCD64A1 burned area and GlobFire event counts from the GWIS country profile. Periods are the source year/month, not NRT weekly chart-axis dates. Annual event counts are retained as published; where monthly counts differ, cross-month event deduplication may differ and counts must not be added as distinct annual fires.

methodology: Historical national observations retain the stated satellite product, source and reporting period. The date field labels the calendar reporting-period end, not a daily observation timestamp. Annual and monthly values are retained separately as published, not reconstructed from NRT weeks. Fire-event aggregation semantics and metric definitions are preserved per source product; monthly event counts must not be assumed additive. The historical product is not concatenated with or used to backfill the GWIS NRT series. Satellite observations do not identify fire causes.
